_doc: §164j (2026-09-26, user decision on Quantmac reply v3: named foreign holders need DOCUMENTARY proof). A holder whose only sign of being foreign is its name (jurisdiction/entity markers, _shp_dii_rowfix.FORLAB or the sovereign-name rule) counts as FII only when listed here. Proof = (filing) the holder appears under a foreign-institution row (FPI/FII/FVCI/FDI/foreign SWF/Institutions(Foreign)) in another cached BSE SHP XBRL, with no domestic listing or >= 90% of >= 5 listings; or (gleif) a GLEIF LEI record with the same legal name (or previous legal name) and a legal jurisdiction outside India. Unlisted name-only holders are unresolved (never FII by name alone).
Built from ~/stocks-cache/shp/proof (corpus_axes.json over 33898 cached XBRLs; proof_gleif.json).

§164n (2026-09-27): + holders the §158a/§164 rest-follows rule had swept into fii while UNRESOLVED (named, no class): 17 documented foreign (other filings' foreign-institution rows / GLEIF), 1 documented DOMESTIC (listed only under Indian rows: INDIA BUSINESS EXCELLENCE FUND IIA = an AIF). Entries now carry class foreign|domestic; holder_class consults this list for EVERY name (exact, or a >= 20-char prefix / >= 0.92 match).
§164r batch 6 (2026-09-29): proof may also be (sebi-register) the holder's own SEBI registration in a SEBI-published list (FVCI/FPI), e.g. NSR-PE Mauritius, LLC IN/FVCI/08-09/119.

§164r batch 7 (2026-09-29, user decision on the Quantmac v5 reply: 'Documents only'). Entries now carry inst=true|false: whether another company's filing lists the same legal name under Institutions (Foreign) (FPI/FII/FVCI/FDI/foreign SWF) — counted over 33,899 cached BSE XBRLs with company-type listings (Foreign Companies / Bodies Corporate / OCB) counted beside it (inst_n / company_n). A holder filed among non-institutions or on a company-type sub-row is FII only on the company's own mark (its first 2022-form row, an (FPI)/FII/FDI tag, its FDI row) or, where the company is silent, inst=true. The SW-2 curated list alone no longer counts (CDC Group plc: 0 institution listings, 64 company-type).

§164r batch 8 (2026-10-04, user decision on Quantmac v6: their evidence standard). Without the company's own mark, inst=true needs >= 90 % of >= 5 classified listings to be Institutions (Foreign) (inst_n vs company_n + domestic_n over 33,899 cached BSE XBRLs, suffix-insensitive same-name match), or a registry document on file (proof sebi-register). 10 holders fell to inst=false: IFC 50 vs 151 company listings, APMS Investment Fund 138 vs 21 (87 %), DVI Fund Mauritius 36 vs 5, Tree Line Asia Master Fund 74 vs 15, Caladium 26 vs 58, Rimco (Mauritius) 13 vs 36, Plenty Private Equity Fund I 7 vs 33, VOF Master 4 + 1.

§164r batch 8 step 4 (2026-10-04): + Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan Board NP3A - ALL from the corpus (1 FPI listing) - RCOM's filings list it inside their Institutions block, where our name filter had read 'Pension' as domestic.

§164r batch 10 (2026-10-04, user 'fix the open items'): inst_n / company_n / domestic_n / inst refreshed for every name from corpus_axes2.json (33,899 cached BSE XBRLs) and every name the corpus lists under Institutions (Foreign) at least once added (inst = >= 90 % of >= 5 classified listings, or a SEBI-register proof); entries the corpus does not carry under the same name keep the counts their own detail text states. Before: 1,163 of 1,204 entries had no counts, so inst_listed() read them as unlisted.
